networks.comment: The only network in this example. Deliberately has no dockside_ip/dockside_mac: the dockside container's own traffic is not exempted, so it is subject to the same egress rules as everything else — see firewall-config.json. That's a fine simplification for a first trial; see ../multi-network-production/ for how to exempt the dockside container on a shared network.
networks.name: dockside
